parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout and switch, channels water from the supply lines to the spout, and anchors the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream into the sink and may include an aerator to control flow and reduce splashing.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
